notes: Thompson's 'Rana esculenta' (Roux). The edible frog is a hybridogenetic klepton (Pelophylax kl. esculentus); WoRMS (1463706) and Wikidata (Q31694) keep it as a species, while the GBIF backbone, NCBI Taxonomy and ITIS all sink it into Pelophylax lessonae: GBIF usage 5784980 (P. esculentus) is a SYNONYM of 2426654 (P. lessonae), NCBI taxid 8401 (P. esculentus) is merged into 45623 (P. lessonae), ITIS TSN 665307 (Rana esculenta) is invalid -> P. lessonae. gbif_usage_key is the P. esculentus usage; ncbi_taxid is the merged target; itis_tsn left null because no valid TSN carries this name.
